abs.name: Ancient Burial Sites

abs.text: Choose 1 player. Exhaust each cultural planet owned by that player.

arch_expedition.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of an exploration deck that matches a planet you control; gain any relic fragments that you reveal and discard the rest.

assassin.name: Assassinate Representative
assassin.text: Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.

blitz.name: Blitz

blitz.text: Each of your non-fighter ships in the active system that do not have BOMBARDMENT gain BOMBARDMENT 6 until the end of the invasion.

bunker.text: During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.

const_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

counterstroke.name: Counterstroke

coup.name: Coup d'Etat

courageous.name: Courageous to the End

courageous.text: Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.

cripple.name: Cripple Defenses

deadly_plot.name: Deadly Plot

decoy.name: Decoy Operation
decoy.window: After another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures
decoy.text: Remove up to 2 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on a planet you control in the active system.

disgrace.name: Public Disgrace

distinguished.name: Distinguished Councilor

divert_funding.name: Divert Funding

dp1.name: Diplomatic Pressure

dp2.name: Diplomatic Pressure

emergency.text: Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.

experimental.name: Experimental Battlestation
experimental.window: After the active player moves ships into the active system during a tactical action
experimental.text: Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5(x3) against the active player's ships in the active system.

f_conscription.name: Fighter Conscription
f_conscription.text: Place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in each system that contains 1 or more of your space docks or units that have capacity. They cannot be placed in systems that contain other players' ships.

f_deployment.name: Frontline Deployment
f_deployment.text: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.

f_prototype.name: Fighter Prototype
f_prototype.window: At the start of the first round of a space combat
f_prototype.text: Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.

f_researched.name: Focused Research
f_researched.text: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology

fire_team.name: Fire Team
fire_team.window: After your ground forces make combat rolls during a round of ground combat
fire_team.text: Reroll any number of your dice.

fsb.text: Gain 3 trade goods. Then, choose another player to gain 1 trade good.

ghost_ship.name: Ghost Ship
ghost_ship.text: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.

ghost_squad.name: Ghost Squad
ghost_squad.window: After another player commits units to land on a planet you control

hack.name: Hack Election
hack.text: During this agenda, you vote last.

imp_rider.name: Imperial Rider
imp_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.

impersonation.name: Impersonation

industrial_initiative.name: Industrial Initiative

infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
infiltrate.window: When you gain control of a planet
infiltrate.text: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

insider.name: Insider Information

insub.name: Insubordination
insub.text: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.

intercept.name: Intercept

intercept.text: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.

investments.name: Manipulate Investments
investments.window: At the start of the strategy phase
investments.text: Place a total of 5 trade goods from the supply on strategy cards of your choice. You must place these tokens on at least 3 different cards.

jamming.name: Signal Jamming
jamming.text: Choose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.

lead_rider.name: Leadership Rider
lead_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.

lost_star.name: Lost Star Chart
lost_star.text: During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.

lucky.name: Lucky Shot

mining_initiative.name: Mining Initiative

plagiarize.text: Spend 5 influence and choose a non-faction technology owned by 1 of your neighbors. Gain that technology.

politic_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.

probe.name: Exploration Probe
probe.text: Explore a frontier token that is in or adjacent to a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

rally.window: After you activate a system that contains another player's ships

refit.name: Refit Troops

reveal_prototype.name: Reveal Prototype

scuttle.text: Choose 1 or 2 of your non-fighter ships on the game board and return them to your reinforcements. Gain trade goods equal to the combined cost of those ships.

seize.name: Seize Artifact

solar_flare.text: During the "Movement" step of this tactical action, other players cannot use SPACE CANNON against your ships.

spy.name: Spy
spy.text: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.

stability.window: When you would return your strategy card(s) during the status phase
stability.text: Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.

summit.window: At the start of the strategy phase

tactical.text: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.

tech_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.

trade_rider.name: Trade Rider
trade_rider.text: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.

unexpected.name: Unexpected Action
unexpected.text: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.

unstable.name: Unstable Planet
unstable.text: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.

upgrade.name: Upgrade
upgrade.window: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your ships

uprising.text: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.

veto.name: Veto
veto.text: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.

crashlanding.window: When your last ship in the active system is destroyed
crashlanding.text: Place 1 of your ground forces from the space area of the active system onto a planet in that system other than Mecatol Rex; if the planet contains other players' units, place your ground force into coexistence.

puppetsonastring.window: At the end of a player's turn, if you have passed

extremeduress.name: Extreme Duress
extremeduress.window: At the start of another player's turn, if they have a readied strategy card
extremeduress.text: If that player's next action is not a strategic action, they discard all of their action cards, give you all of their trade goods, and show you all of their secret objectives.

overrule.name: Overrule
overrule.text: Perform the primary ability of a readied or unchosen strategy card.

blackmarketdealing.name: Black Market Dealings
blackmarketdealing.window: When you are negotiating a transaction
blackmarketdealing.text: You and the other player may include relics, action cards, and unscored secret objectives as part of the transaction. This card cannot be canceled.

mercenarycontract.name: Mercenary Contract
mercenarycontract.text: Spend 2 trade goods to place 2 neutral infantry on any non-home planet that contains no units; if that planet was owned by another player, they return its planet card to the planet card deck.

amass_wealth.name: Amass Wealth
amass_wealth.text: Spend 3 influence, 3 resources, and 3 trade goods.

corner.name: Corner the Market

deep_space.name: Explore Deep Space

engineer_marvel.name: Engineer a Marvel

lead.name: Lead From the Front

make_history.name: Make History

outer_rim.name: Populate the Outer Rim

push_boundaries.name: Push Boundaries

bam.name: Become a Martyr

btv.name: Brave the Void

btgk.name: Become the Gatekeeper

ctr.name: Control the Region

dfat.name: Defy Space and Time

dhw.name: Destroy Heretical Works

dtgs.name: Destroy Their Greatest Ship

dts.name: Darken the Skies

dyp.name: Demonstrate Your Power

eap.name: Establish a Perimeter

fwm.name: Fuel the War Machine

gamf.name: Gather a Mighty Fleet

hrm.name: Hoard Raw Materials

ose.text: Control Mecatol Rex and have 3 or more ships in its system.

otf.name: Occupy the Fringe
otf.text: Have 9 or more ground forces on a planet that does not contain 1 of your space docks.

pe.name: Prove Endurance
pe.text: Be the last player to pass during a game round.

pem.name: Produce en Masse
pem.text: Have units with a combined PRODUCTION value of at least 8 in a single system.

sar.name: Spark a Rebellion
sar.text: Win a combat against a player who has the most victory points.

sb.name: Strengthen Bonds
sb.text: Have another player's promissory note in your play area.

syc.name: Stake Your Claim
syc.text: Control a planet in a system that contains a planet controlled by another player.

te.name: Threaten Enemies
te.text: Have 1 or more ships in a system that is adjacent to another player's home system.

ttfd.name: Turn Their Fleets to Dust
ttfd.text: Destroy the last of a player's non-fighter ships in the active system during the space cannon offense step.

uf.name: Unveil Flagship
uf.text: Win a space combat in a system that contains your flagship. You cannot score this objective if your flagship is destroyed in the combat.

agenda_abolishment.name: Judicial Abolishment
agenda_abolishment.target: Elect Law (When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.)
agenda_abolishment.for: Discard the elected law from play.

agenda_arbiter.name: Imperial Arbiter
agenda_arbiter.for: The elected player gains this card. At the end of the strategy phase, the owner of this card may discard this card to swap 1 of their strategy cards with 1 of another player's strategy cards.

agenda_arms_reduction.name: Arms Reduction
agenda_arms_reduction.for: For: Each player destroys all but 2 of their dreadnoughts and all but 4 of their cruisers.
agenda_arms_reduction.against: Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each of their planets that have a technology specialty.

agenda_artifact.name: Ixthian Artifact
agenda_artifact.for: For: The speaker rolls 1 die. If the result is 6-10, each player may research 2 technologies. If the result is 1-5, destroy all units in Mecatol Rex's system, and each player with units in systems adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system destroys 3 of their own units in each of those systems.

agenda_classified.name: Classified Document Leaks
agenda_classified.target: Elect Scored Secret Objective (When this agenda is revealed, if there are no scored secret objectives, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.)
agenda_classified.for: The elected secret objective becomes a public objective - place it near the other public objectives in the common play area.

agenda_committee.name: Committee Formation
agenda_committee.for: The elected player gains this card. Before players vote on an agenda that requires a player to be elected, the owner of this card may discard this card to choose a player to be elected. Players do not vote on that agenda.

agenda_conscription.name: Regulated Conscription
agenda_conscription.for: For: When a player produces units, they produce only 1 fighter and infantry for its cost instead of 2.

agenda_constitution.name: New Constitution
agenda_constitution.for: (When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.) For: Discard all laws from play. At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each planet in their home system.

agenda_conventions.name: Conventions of War
agenda_conventions.for: For: Players cannot use BOMBARDMENT against units that are on cultural planets.
agenda_conventions.against: Against: Each player that voted "Against" discards all of their action cards.

agenda_defense_act.name: Homeland Defense Act
agenda_defense_act.for: For: Each player can have any number of PDS units on planets they control.
agenda_defense_act.against: Against: Each player destroys 1 of their PDS units.

agenda_disarmament.name: Compensated Disarmament
agenda_disarmament.for: Destroy each ground force on the elected planet. For each unit that was destroyed, the player who control that planet gains 1 trade good.

agenda_economic_equality.name: Economic Equality
agenda_economic_equality.for: For: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply. Then, each player gains 5 trade goods.
agenda_economic_equality.against: Against: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply.

agenda_execution.name: Public Execution
agenda_execution.for: The elected player discards all of their action cards. If they have the speaker token, they give it to the player on their left. The elected player cannot vote on any agendas during this agenda phase.

agenda_incentive.name: Incentive Program
agenda_incentive.for: For: Draw and reveal 1 stage I public objective from the deck and place it near the public objectives.
agenda_incentive.against: Against: Draw and reveal 1 stage II public from the deck and place it near the public objectives.

agenda_minister_commerce.name: Minister of Commerce
agenda_minister_commerce.for: The elected player gains this card. After the owner of this card replenishes commodities, they gain 1 trade good for each player that is their neighbor.

agenda_minister_exploration.name: Minister of Exploration
agenda_minister_exploration.for: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card gains control of a planet, they gain 1 trade good.

agenda_minister_industry.name: Minister of Industry
agenda_minister_industry.for: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card places a space dock in a system, their units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities.

agenda_minister_peace.name: Minister of Peace
agenda_minister_peace.for: The elected player gains this card. After a player activates a system that contains 1 or more of a different player's units, the owner of this card may discard this card - immediately end the active player's turn.

agenda_minister_policy.name: Minister of Policy
agenda_minister_policy.for: The elected player gains this card. At the end of the status phase, the owner of this card draws 1 action card.

agenda_minister_sciences.name: Minister of Sciences
agenda_minister_sciences.for: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card resolves the primary or secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card, they do not need to spend resources to research technology.

agenda_minister_war.name: Minister of War
agenda_minister_war.for: The elected player gains this card. The owner of this card may discard this card after performing an action to remove 1 of their command tokens from the game board and return it to their reinforcements - then they may perform 1 additional action.

agenda_miscount.name: Miscount Disclosed
agenda_miscount.for: (When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.) Vote on the elected law as if it were just revealed from the top of the deck.

agenda_mutiny.name: Mutiny
agenda_mutiny.for: For: Each player that voted "For" gains 1 victory point.
agenda_mutiny.against: Against: Each player that voted "For" loses 1 victory point.

agenda_plowshares.name: Swords to Plowshares
agenda_plowshares.for: For: Each player destroys half of their infantry on each planet they control, rounded up. Then, each player gains trade goods equal to the number of their infantry that were destroyed.
agenda_plowshares.against: Against: Each player places 1 infantry from their reinforcements on each planet they control.

agenda_prophecy.name: Prophecy of Ixth
agenda_prophecy.for: The elected player gains this card. The owner of this card applies +1 to the result of their fighter's combat rolls. When the owner of this card uses PRODUCTION, they discard this card unless they produce 2 or more fighters.

agenda_redistribution.name: Colonial Redistribution
agenda_redistribution.target: Elect Non-Home Planet Other Than Mecatol Rex
agenda_redistribution.for: Destroy each unit on the elected planet. Then, the player who controls that planet chooses 1 player with the fewest victory points - that player may place 1 infantry from their reinforcements on that planet.

agenda_regulations.name: Fleet Regulations
agenda_regulations.for: For: Each player cannot have more than 4 tokens in their fleet pool.
agenda_regulations.against: Against: Each player places 1 command token from their reinforcements in their fleet pool.

agenda_revolution.name: Anti-Intellectual Revolution
agenda_revolution.for: For: After a player researches a technology, that player must destroy 1 of their non-fighter ships.
agenda_revolution.against: Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player chooses and exhausts 1 planet for each technology that they own.

agenda_sanctions.name: Executive Sanctions
agenda_sanctions.for: For: Each player can have a maximum of 3 action cards in their hand.
agenda_sanctions.against: Against: Each player discards 1 random action card from their hand.

agenda_schematics.name: Publicize Weapon Schematics
agenda_schematics.for: For: If any player owns a war sun technology, all players may ignore all prerequisites on war sun technologies. All war suns lose SUSTAIN DAMAGE.
agenda_schematics.against: Against: Each player that owns a war sun technology discards all of their action cards.

agenda_secret.name: Archived Secret
agenda_secret.for: The elected player draws 1 secret objective.

agenda_seed_empire.name: Seed of an Empire
agenda_seed_empire.for: For: The player with the most victory points gains 1 victory point.
agenda_seed_empire.against: Against: The player with the fewest victory points gains 1 victory point.

agenda_shared_research.name: Shared Research
agenda_shared_research.for: For: Each player's units can move through nebulae.
agenda_shared_research.against: Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in their home system, if able.

agenda_travel_ban.name: Enforced Travel Ban
agenda_travel_ban.for: For: Alpha and beta wormholes have no effect during movement.
agenda_travel_ban.against: Against: Destroy each PDS in or adjacent to a system that contains a wormhole.

agenda_unconventional.name: Unconventional Measures
agenda_unconventional.for: For: Each player that voted "For" draws 2 action cards.
agenda_unconventional.against: Against: Each player that voted "For" discards all of their action cards.

agenda_wormhole_recon.name: Wormhole Reconstruction
agenda_wormhole_recon.for: For: All systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole are adjacent to each other.
agenda_wormhole_recon.against: Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in each system that contains a wormhole and 1 or more of their ships.

agenda_wormhole_research.name: Wormhole Research
agenda_wormhole_research.for: For: Each player who has 1 or more ships in a system that contains a wormhole may research 1 technology. Then, destroy all ships in systems that contain an alpha or beta wormhole.
agenda_wormhole_research.against: Against: Each player that voted "Against" removes 1 command token from their command sheet and returns it to their reinforcements.

agenda_core_mining.name: Core Mining
agenda_core_mining.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. Then, destroy 1 infantry on the planet. The resource value of this planet is increased by 2.

agenda_demilitarized_zone.name: Demilitarized Zone
agenda_demilitarized_zone.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. Then, destroy all units on that planet. Player's units cannot land, be produced, or be placed on this planet.

agenda_holy_planet_of_ixth.name: Holy Planet of Ixth
agenda_holy_planet_of_ixth.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The planet's owner gains 1 victory point. Units on this planet cannot use PRODUCTION. When a player gains control of this planet, they gain 1 victory point. When a player loses control of this planet, they lose 1 victory point.

agenda_representative_government.name: Representative Government (Base Game)
agenda_representative_government.for: For: Players cannot exhaust planets to cast votes during the agenda phase. Each player may cast 1 vote on each agenda instead.
agenda_representative_government.against: Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player that voted "Against" exhausts all of their cultural planets.

agenda_rt_biotic.name: Research Team: Biotic
agenda_rt_biotic.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 green prerequisite.

agenda_rt_cybernetic.name: Research Team: Cybernetic
agenda_rt_cybernetic.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 yellow prerequisite.

agenda_rt_propulsion.name: Research Team: Propulsion
agenda_rt_propulsion.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 blue prerequisite.

agenda_rt_warfare.name: Research Team: Warfare
agenda_rt_warfare.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 red prerequisite.

agenda_senate_sanctuary.name: Senate Sanctuary
agenda_senate_sanctuary.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The influence value of this planet is increased by 2.

agenda_shard_of_the_throne.name: Shard of the Throne
agenda_shard_of_the_throne.for: The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point. A player gains this card and 1 victory point when they win a combat against the owner of this card. Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.

agenda_terraforming_initiative.name: Terraforming Initiative
agenda_terraforming_initiative.for: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The resource and influence values of this planet are increased by 1.

agenda_crown_of_emphidia.name: The Crown of Emphidia
agenda_crown_of_emphidia.for: The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point. A player gains this card and 1 victory point after they gain control of a planet in the home system of this card's owner. Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.

agenda_crown_of_thalnos.name: The Crown of Thalnos
agenda_crown_of_thalnos.for: The elected player gains this card. During each combat round, the owner of this card may reroll any number of dice; they must destroy each of their units that did not produce a hit with its reroll.

agenda_articles_war.name: Articles of War
agenda_articles_war.for: For: All mechs lose their printed abilities except for SUSTAIN DAMAGE.
agenda_articles_war.against: Against: Each player that voted "For" gains 3 trade goods.

agenda_censure.name: Political Censure
agenda_censure.for: The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point. The elected player cannot play action cards. If the owner of this card loses this card, they lose 1 victory point.

agenda_checks.name: Checks and Balances
agenda_checks.for: For: When a player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase, they give that strategy card to another player who does not have 1 (or a player who does not have 2 in a three- or four-player game), if able.
agenda_checks.against: Against: Each player readies only 3 of their planets at the end of this agenda phase.

agenda_cladenstine.name: Clandestine Operations
agenda_cladenstine.for: For: Each player removes 2 command tokens from their command sheet and returns those tokens to their reinforcements.
agenda_cladenstine.against: Against: Each player removes 1 command token from their fleet pool and returns that token to their reinforcements.

agenda_covert.name: Covert Legislation
agenda_covert.target: When this agenda is revealed, the speaker draws the next card in the agenda deck but does not reveal it to the other players. Instead, the speaker reads the eligible outcomes aloud (for, against, elect Elect Player, etc.). The other Players vote for these outcomes as if they were outcomes of this agenda, without knowing their effects.

agenda_crisis.name: Galactic Crisis Pact
agenda_crisis.for: Each player may perform the secondary ability of the elected strategy card without spending a command token - command tokens placed by the ability are placed from a player's reinforcements instead.

agenda_grant_reallocation.name: Research Grant Reallocation
agenda_grant_reallocation.for: The elected player gains any 1 technology of their choice. Then, for each prerequisite on that technology, they remove 1 token from their fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements.

agenda_nexus.name: Nexus Sovereignty
agenda_nexus.for: For: Alpha and beta wormholes in the wormhole nexus have no effect during movement.
agenda_nexus.against: Against: Place a gamma wormhole token in the Mecatol Rex system.

agenda_rearmament.name: Rearmament Agreement
agenda_rearmament.for: For: Each player places 1 mech from their reinforcements on a planet they control in their home system.
agenda_rearmament.against: Against: Each player replaces each of their mechs with 1 infantry from their reinforcements.

agenda_rep_govt.name: Representative Government
agenda_rep_govt.for: For: Players cannot exhaust planets to cast votes during the agenda phase. each player may cast 1 vote on each agenda instead. Players cannot cast additional votes.
agenda_rep_govt.against: Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player that voted "Against" exhausts all of their cultural planets.

agenda_standardization.name: Armed Forces Standardization
agenda_standardization.for: The elected player place command tokens from their reinforcements so that they have 3 tokens in their tactic pool, 3 tokens in their fleet pool, and 2 tokens in their strategy pool. They return any excess tokens to their reinforcements.

agenda_warrant.name: Search Warrant
agenda_warrant.for: The elected player gains this card and draws 2 secret objectives. The owner of this card plays with their secret objectives revealed.

relic_codex.name: The Codex
relic_codex.text: ACTION: Purge this card to take up to 3 action cards of your choice from the action card discard pile.

relic_dominusorb.name: Dominus Orb
relic_dominusorb.text: Before you move units during a tactical action, you may purge this card to move and transport units that are in systems that contain 1 of your command tokens.

relic_dynamiscore.name: Dynamis Core
relic_dynamiscore.text:
While this card is in your play area, your commodity value is increased by 2.
ACTION: Gain trade goods equal to your commodity value, then purge this card.

relic_emelpar.name: Scepter of Emelpar
relic_emelpar.text: When you would spend a token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust this card to spend a token from your reinforcements instead.

relic_emphidia.name: The Crown of Emphidia
relic_emphidia.text: After you perform a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control. At the end of the status phase, if you control the "Tomb of Emphidia," you may purge this card to gain 1 victory point.

relic_mawofworlds.name: Maw of Worlds
relic_mawofworlds.text: At the start of the agenda phase, you may purge this card and exhaust all of your planets to gain any 1 technology.

relic_nanoforge.name: Nano-Forge
relic_nanoforge.text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-legendary, non-home planet you control, its resource and influence values are increased by 2 and it is a legendary planet. This action cannot be performed once attached.

relic_obsidian.name: The Obsidian
relic_obsidian.text: When you gain this card, draw 1 secret objective. You can have 1 additional scored or unscored secret objective.

relic_prophetstears.name: The Prophet's Tears
relic_prophetstears.text: When you research a technology, you may exhaust this card to ignore 1 prerequisite or draw 1 action card.

relic_shard.name: Shard of the Throne
relic_shard.text: When you gain this card, gain 1 victory point, when you lose this card, lose 1 victory point. When a player gains control of a legendary planet you control or a planet you control in your home system, that player gains this card.

relic_stellarconverter.name: Stellar Converter
relic_stellarconverter.text: ACTION: Choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet other than Mecatol Rex in a system that is adjacent to 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT, destroy all units on that planet and purge its attachments and its planet card. Then, place the destroyed planet token on that planet and purge this card.

relic_thalnos.name: The Crown of Thalnos
relic_thalnos.text: During each combat round, this card's owner may reroll any number of their dice, applying +1 to the results, any units that reroll dice but do not produce at least 1 hit are destroyed.

relic_titanprototype.name: JR-XS455-O
relic_titanprototype.text: ACTION: Exhaust this agent and choose a player, that player may spend 3 resources to place a structure on a planet they control. If they do not, they gain 1 trade good.

relic_bookoflatvinia.name: Book of Latvinia
relic_bookoflatvinia.text:
When you gain this card, research up to 2 technologies that have no prerequisites.
> ACTION: Purge this card; if you control planets that have all 4 types of technology specialties, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, gain the speaker token.

relic_circletofthevoid.name: Circlet of the Void
relic_circletofthevoid.text:
Your units do not roll for gravity rifts, and you ignore the effects of all other anomalies on movement.

ACTION: Exhaust this card to explore a frontier token in a system that does not contain any other players' ships.

relic_heartofixth.name: Heart of Ixth
relic_heartofixth.text: After any die is rolled, you may exhaust this card to add or subtract 1 from its result.

relic_lightrailordnance.name: Lightrail Ordnance
relic_lightrailordnance.text: Your space docks gain SPACE CANNON 5 (x2). You may use your space dock's SPACE CANNON against ships that are adjacent to their systems.

relic_metalivoidarmaments.name: Metali Void Armaments
relic_metalivoidarmaments.text: During the "Anti-Fighter Barrage" step of space combat, you may resolve ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 6 (x3) against your opponent's units.

relic_metalivoidshielding.name: Metali Void Shielding
relic_metalivoidshielding.text: Each time hits are produced against 1 or more of your non-fighter ships, 1 of those ships may use SUSTAIN DAMAGE as if it had that ability.

relic_neuraloop.name: Neuraloop
relic_neuraloop.text: When a public objective is revealed, you may purge one of your relics to discard that objective and replace it with a random objective from any objective deck; that objective is a public objective, even if it is a secret objective.

relic_quantumcore.name: The Quantumcore
relic_quantumcore.text: When you gain this card, gain your breakthrough. You have SYNERGY for all technology types.

relic_thesilverflame.name: The Silver Flame
relic_thesilverflame.text:
The Silver Flame may be exchanged as part of a transaction.
> ACTION: Roll 1 die and purge this card; if the result is a 10, gain 1 victory point. Otherwise, purge your home system and all units in it; you cannot score public objectives. Put The Fracture into play if it is not already.

relic_thetriad.name: The Triad
relic_thetriad.text: This card can be readied and spent as if it were a planet card. Its resource and influence values are equal to 3 plus the number of different types of relic fragments you own.

pok1leadership.name: Leadership
primary: Gain 3 command tokens
Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent
secondary: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent

pok2diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
primary: Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in the chosen system. Then, ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.

pok3politics.name: Politics
primary: Choose a player other than the speaker.  That player gains the speaker token.
Draw 2 action cards
Look at the top 2 cards of the agenda deck. Place each card on the top or bottom of the deck in any order.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 2 action cards.

base4.name: Construction
primary: Place 1 PDS or 1 Space Dock on a planet you control.
Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.
secondary: Place 1 token from your strategy pool in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system.

pok5trade.name: Trade
primary: Gain 3 trade goods.
Replenish commodities.
Choose any number of other players. Those players use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to replenish your commodities.

pok6warfare.name: Warfare
primary: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board; then, gain 1 command token.
Redistribute any number of the command tokens on your command sheet.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in your home system (this token is not placed in your home system).

pok7technology.name: Technology
primary: Research 1 technology.
Spend 6 resources to research 1 technology.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and 4 resources to research 1 technology.

pok8imperial.name: Imperial
primary: Immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements.
Gain 1 victory point if you control Mecatol Rex; otherwise, draw 1 secret objective.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 1 secret objective.

pok4construction.name: Construction
primary: Place 1 PDS or 1 Space Dock on a planet you control.
Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and place it in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system

te4construction.name: Construction
primary: Either place 1 structure on a planet you control, or use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks.
Place 1 structure on a planet you control.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 1 structure on a planet you control.

te6warfare.name: Warfare
primary: Perform a tactical action in any system without placing a command token, even if the system already has your command token in it: that system still counts as being activated. You may redistribute your command tokens before and after this action.
secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the Production abilities of the units in your home system. (This token is not placed in your home system)

tech_amd.name: Antimass Deflectors
tech_amd.text:
Your ships can move into and through asteroid fields.
When other players' units use SPACE CANNON against your units, apply -1 to the result of each die roll.

tech_gd.name: Gravity Drive
tech_gd.text: After you activate a system, apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this tactical action.

tech_fl.name: Fleet Logistics
tech_fl.text: During each of your turns of the action phase, you may perform 2 actions instead of 1.

tech_lwd.name: Light/Wave Deflector
tech_lwd.text: Your ships can move through systems that contain other players' ships.

tech_nm.name: Neural Motivator
tech_nm.text: During the status phase, draw 2 action cards instead of 1.

tech_dxa.name: Dacxive Animators
tech_dxa.text: After you win a ground combat, you may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.

tech_hm.name: Hyper Metabolism
tech_hm.text: During the status phase, gain 3 command tokens instead of 2.

tech_x89c4.name: X-89 Bacterial Weapon ΩΩ
tech_x89c4.text:
Double the hits produced by your units' BOMBARDMENT and ground combat rolls.
Exhaust each planet you use BOMBARDMENT against.

tech_ps.name: Plasma Scoring
tech_ps.text: When 1 or more of your units use BOMBARDMENT or SPACE CANNON, 1 of those units may roll 1 additional die.

tech_md.name: Magen Defense Grid ΩΩ
tech_md.text:
When any player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements with each of those structures.
At the start of ground combat on a planet that contains 1 or more of your structures, produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponent's ground forces.

tech_da.name: Duranium Armor
tech_da.text: During each combat round, after you assign hits to your units, repair 1 of your damaged units that did not use SUSTAIN DAMAGE during this combat round.

tech_asc.name: Assault Cannon
tech_asc.text: At the start of a space combat in a system that contains 3 or more of your non-fighter ships, your opponent must destroy 1 of their non-fighter ships.

tech_st.name: Sarween Tools
tech_st.text: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

tech_gls.name: Graviton Laser System
tech_gls.text: You may exhaust this card before 1 or more of your units uses SPACE CANNON; hits produced by those units must be assigned to non-fighter ships if able.

tech_td.name: Transit Diodes
tech_td.text: You may exhaust this card at the start of your turn during the action phase; remove up to 4 of your ground forces from the game board and place them on 1 or more planets you control.

tech_ie.name: Integrated Economy
tech_ie.text: After you gain control of a planet, you may produce any number of units on that planet that have a combined cost equal to or less than that planet's resource value.

tech_ws.name: War Sun
tech_ws.text:
Cost 12, Combat 3(x3), Move 2, Capacity 6
SUSTAIN DAMAGE, BOMBARDMENT 3(x3)
 Other players' units in this system lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

tech_sd2.name: Space Dock II
tech_sd2.text:
PRODUCTION X
This unit's PRODUCTION value is equal to 4 more than the resource value of this planet.
Up to 3 fighters in this system do not count against your ships' capacity.

tech_lw2.name: Letani Warrior II
tech_lw2.text:
Cost 1(x2), Combat 7
PRODUCTION 2
After this unit is destroyed, roll 1 die. If the result is 6 or greater, place the unit on this card. At the start of your next turn, place each unit that is on this card on a planet you control in your home system.

tech_l4.name: L4 Disruptors
